+/*

+	Date   : 2026-10-19
+	Module : FAM

+		- Không Drop, Update hoặc Delete dữ liệu/object.
+*/
+Set Nocount On
+Go
+
+-- 1. Object và định nghĩa store legacy (nếu còn tồn tại).
+Select
+	DatabaseName = Db_Name(),
+	SchemaName = Object_Schema_Name(sys.objects.object_id),
+	ObjectName = sys.objects.name,
+	ObjectType = sys.objects.type_desc,
+	IsLegacyLookup = Case
+		When sys.objects.object_id = Object_Id(N'[dbo].[FAM_DeviceDep_GetByDeviceAndYear]') Then 1
+		Else 0
+	End
+From sys.objects
+Where sys.objects.object_id In
+(
+	Object_Id(N'[dbo].[FAM_DeviceDep]'),
+	Object_Id(N'[dbo].[FAM_DeviceDep_GetByDeviceAndYear]')
+)
+Order By sys.objects.type_desc
+
+Select
+	ObjectName = N'dbo.FAM_DeviceDep_GetByDeviceAndYear',
+	ObjectDefinition = Object_Definition(Object_Id(N'[dbo].[FAM_DeviceDep_GetByDeviceAndYear]'))
+Where Object_Id(N'[dbo].[FAM_DeviceDep_GetByDeviceAndYear]', N'P') Is Not Null
+
+-- 2. Dependency SQL được hệ thống ghi nhận.
+Select
+	ReferencingSchema = Object_Schema_Name(sys.sql_expression_dependencies.referencing_id),
+	ReferencingObject = Object_Name(sys.sql_expression_dependencies.referencing_id),
+	ReferencingType = sys.objects.type_desc,
+	ReferencedSchema = sys.sql_expression_dependencies.referenced_schema_name,
+	ReferencedObject = sys.sql_expression_dependencies.referenced_entity_name
+From sys.sql_expression_dependencies
+	Inner Join sys.objects
+		on sys.objects.object_id = sys.sql_expression_dependencies.referencing_id
+Where sys.sql_expression_dependencies.referenced_id In
+(
+	Object_Id(N'[dbo].[FAM_DeviceDep]'),
+	Object_Id(N'[dbo].[FAM_DeviceDep_GetByDeviceAndYear]')
+)
+	or
+	(
+		sys.sql_expression_dependencies.referenced_schema_name = N'dbo'
+		and sys.sql_expression_dependencies.referenced_entity_name In
+		(
+			N'FAM_DeviceDep',
+			N'FAM_DeviceDep_GetByDeviceAndYear'
+		)
+	)
+Order By
+	ReferencingSchema,
+	ReferencingObject
+
+-- 3. Module chứa tham chiếu dạng text mà dependency metadata có thể không bắt được.
+Select
+	SchemaName = Object_Schema_Name(sys.sql_modules.object_id),
+	ObjectName = Object_Name(sys.sql_modules.object_id),
+	ObjectType = sys.objects.type_desc,
+	MatchedReference = Case
+		When sys.sql_modules.definition Like N'%FAM_DeviceDep_GetByDeviceAndYear%'
+			Then N'FAM_DeviceDep_GetByDeviceAndYear'
+		Else N'FAM_DeviceDep'
+	End
+From sys.sql_modules
+	Inner Join sys.objects
+		on sys.objects.object_id = sys.sql_modules.object_id
+Where sys.sql_modules.definition Like N'%FAM_DeviceDep_GetByDeviceAndYear%'
+	or sys.sql_modules.definition Like N'%FAM_DeviceDep%'
+Order By
+	SchemaName,
+	ObjectName
+
+-- 4. Dòng legacy nghi là dữ liệu kiểm kê: số tiền rất nhỏ và khớp số lượng tài sản.
+Select
+	FAM_DeviceDep.DeviceDepID,
+	FAM_DeviceDep.YearID,
+	FAM_DeviceDep.DeviceID,
+	FAM_Device.DeviceCode,
+	FAM_Device.DeviceName,
+	FAM_Device.Quantity,
+	FAM_Device.Price,
+	FAM_Device.RemainPrice As DeviceRemainPrice,
+	FAM_DeviceDep.CurrentPrice,
+	FAM_DeviceDep.DepPercent,

+	FAM_DeviceDep.RemainPrice,
+	SuspicionReason = N'CurrentPrice/DepValue có dạng số lượng kiểm kê, không giống giá trị khấu hao.'
+From [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDep]
+	Inner Join [dbo].[FAM_Device]
+		on FAM_Device.DeviceID = FAM_DeviceDep.DeviceID
+Where
+	(
+		Abs(Convert(decimal(18,2), Isnull(FAM_DeviceDep.CurrentPrice, 0)))
+			<= Abs(Convert(decimal(18,2), Isnull(FAM_Device.Quantity, 0))) + 100
+		or Abs(Convert(decimal(18,2), Isnull(FAM_DeviceDep.DepValue, 0)))
+			<= Abs(Convert(decimal(18,2), Isnull(FAM_Device.Quantity, 0))) + 100
+	)
+	and Abs(Convert(decimal(18,2), Isnull(FAM_Device.Price, 0))) >= 1000
+	and
+	(
+		Abs(Convert(decimal(18,2), Isnull(FAM_DeviceDep.CurrentPrice, 0))) < 1000
+		or Abs(Convert(decimal(18,2), Isnull(FAM_DeviceDep.DepValue, 0))) < 1000
+	)
+Order By
+	FAM_DeviceDep.YearID Desc,
+	FAM_Device.DeviceCode
+
+-- 5. Dòng legacy bất thường về cân đối/miền giá trị.
+Select
+	FAM_DeviceDep.DeviceDepID,
+	FAM_DeviceDep.YearID,
+	FAM_DeviceDep.DeviceID,
+	FAM_Device.DeviceCode,
+	FAM_Device.DeviceName,
+	FAM_DeviceDep.CurrentPrice,
+	FAM_DeviceDep.DepPercent,
+	FAM_DeviceDep.DepValue,
+	FAM_DeviceDep.RemainPrice
+From [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDep]
+	Left Join [dbo].[FAM_Device]
+		on FAM_Device.DeviceID = FAM_DeviceDep.DeviceID
+Where FAM_DeviceDep.CurrentPrice < 0
+	or FAM_DeviceDep.DepValue < 0
+	or FAM_DeviceDep.RemainPrice < 0
+	or FAM_DeviceDep.DepPercent < 0
+	or FAM_DeviceDep.DepPercent > 100
+	or Convert(decimal(18,2), Isnull(FAM_DeviceDep.CurrentPrice, 0))
+		<> Convert(decimal(18,2), Isnull(FAM_DeviceDep.DepValue, 0))
+			+ Convert(decimal(18,2), Isnull(FAM_DeviceDep.RemainPrice, 0))
+Order By
+	FAM_DeviceDep.YearID Desc,
+	FAM_DeviceDep.DeviceID
+Go

+				When CalculationSource.OpeningValue <= 0 Then N'Đã khấu hao hết.'
+				Else N'Đủ điều kiện ghi nhận.'
+			End As ResultMessage
+		From CalculationSource
